issues.title: Broken Server-Side Dependencies (GAPs)
issues.why: The spec identifies GAP-22-03 (Streaming format) and GAP-22-04 (PreviousHasError field) as missing in the server spec (folder 22), which are critical for the CLI's core logic.
issues.fix: Update spec/22-git-logs-v2 to include NDJSON streaming and the PreviousHasError boolean in the ack envelope.

issues.title: Inter-process Concurrency Race
issues.why: The spec allows --parallel for runtimes but does not specify how interleaved stdout/stderr from different runtimes is handled before shipping to prevent log corruption.
issues.fix: Explicitly state that each runtime in parallel mode must use a thread-safe buffer or separate ship queue to prevent line interleaving.

issues.title: Truncated Context
issues.why: The provided file content for 08-ci-provider-bindings.md is truncated, leaving the harvest map for Azure and Bitbucket incomplete for the coder.
issues.fix: Provide the full harvest map table for all CI providers in section 08.
